passage.text: Hi, Nam. I have some sad news.
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm. aɪ ˈhæv sʌm ˈsæd ˈnuːz.

passage.text: My café is closing down at the end of this month.
passage.reading: maɪ kæˈfeɪ ɪz ˈkloʊzɪŋ ˈdaʊn ət ði ˈɛnd əv ðɪs ˈmʌnθ.

passage.text: I thought it was going really well. You had so many regular customers!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈθɔːt ɪt wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈriːli ˈwɛl. juː ˈhæd soʊ ˈmɛni ˈrɛɡjələr ˈkʌstəmərz!

passage.text: We had some regular customers, but not enough.
passage.reading: wiː ˈhæd sʌm ˈrɛɡjələr ˈkʌstəmərz, bʌt ˈnɑːt ɪˈnʌf.

passage.text: Then a big coffee chain opened a branch across the street, and lots of people started going there instead.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkɔːfi ˌtʃeɪn ˈoʊpənd ə ˈbræntʃ əˈkrɔːs ðə ˈstriːt, ənd ˈlɑːts əv ˈpiːpəl ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈðɛr ɪnˈstɛd.

passage.text: After that, the landlord raised the rent by 30%.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈðæt, ðə ˈlændlɔːrd ˈreɪzd ðə ˈrɛnt baɪ ˈθɜːrti pərˈsɛnt.

passage.text: For three months, I paid the bills with my own savings.
passage.reading: fər ˈθriː ˈmʌnθs, aɪ ˈpeɪd ðə ˈbɪlz wɪð maɪ ˈoʊn ˈseɪvɪŋz.

passage.text: If I don't close now, I'll go bankrupt.
passage.reading: ɪf aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈkloʊz ˈnaʊ, aɪl ˈɡoʊ ˈbæŋkrʌpt.

passage.text: I'm so sorry. You worked so hard, and your coffee was the best!
passage.reading: aɪm soʊ ˈsɑːri. juː ˈwɜːrkt soʊ ˈhɑːrd, ənd jʊr ˈkɔːfi wʌz ðə ˈbɛst!

passage.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
passage.reading: ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪ kən ˈduː tə ˈhɛlp?

passage.text: Thanks, Nam. Don't worry, I'll survive!
passage.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm. ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri, aɪl sərˈvaɪv!

passage.text: I've learned a lot this year.
passage.reading: aɪv ˈlɜːrnd ə ˈlɑːt ðɪs ˈjɪr.

passage.text: Next time, I'll do more market research before I sign a contract.
passage.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm, aɪl ˈduː ˈmɔːr ˈmɑːrkɪt ˌriːsɜːrtʃ bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈsaɪn ə ˈkɑːntrækt.

passage.text: And maybe I'll start by selling coffee online, where the running costs aren't so high.
passage.reading: ənd ˈmeɪbi aɪl ˈstɑːrt baɪ ˈsɛlɪŋ ˈkɔːfi ˌɑːnˈlaɪn, wɛr ðə ˈrʌnɪŋ ˌkɔːsts ˈɑːrnt soʊ ˈhaɪ.

passage.text: Come to the café before it closes. Your coffee will be free!
passage.reading: ˈkʌm tə ðə kæˈfeɪ bɪˈfɔːr ɪt ˈkloʊzɪz. jʊr ˈkɔːfi wɪl bi ˈfriː!
